coverage: Reviewed public sources; not a complete feed from every PESO office.

sources.name: Provincial Government / PESO
sources.notes: Current provincial careers table rows have a November 8, 2026 application deadline. These are government HR postings, not connected PESO partner vacancies.

sources.name: San Jose Municipal PESO
sources.notes: A new Taiwan recruitment announcement was indexed, but direct source access could not be rechecked. No expired registration window was treated as open.

sources.name: Provincial Government of Palawan
sources.notes: The careers table contains 2023 government deadlines and August 2024 private listings marked Open. Their current availability could not be verified, so they were not imported as current jobs. This does not mean no jobs exist.

sources.name: City PESO contact directory
sources.notes: Use the official City PESO contact entry to check local openings.

sources.name: Pasay City PESO
sources.notes: Applications are linked individually. Remaining vacancies are not confirmed by page access alone.

sources.name: PESO Negros Occidental
sources.notes: Individual public details and future deadlines were checked. The portal advertises 60; only 54 distinct accessible details were verified.

sources.name: Provincial PESO
sources.notes: Includes the November 11 recruitment activity in Pili. Multi-role announcements are kept as single records.

sources.name: Provincial PESO · CFO BaLinkBayan
sources.notes: The public board lists employers/agencies and role names. It does not confirm current deadlines, destination countries or remaining places; verify with PESO and DMW before applying.

sources.name: Cauayan City PESO
sources.notes: The public board had a listing, but details required sign-in and no current deadline was confirmed.

sources.name: Mati City PESO
sources.notes: Public entries lacked complete current application evidence. A test-only posting and duplicate/stale candidates were not imported.

sources.name: WorkIN / Provincial PESO
sources.notes: The public home response had no recent vacancy records.

sources.name: Cebu Provincial PESO
sources.notes: The official board displayed zero available jobs at review time.

sources.name: DOLE VIII · HIRE-EV
sources.notes: Government launch was verified. Aggregated partner-board jobs were not imported as confirmed PESO openings, and removed PhilJobNet links were not reintroduced.

sources.name: Bureau of Local Employment PESO directory
sources.notes: The directory is the official starting point for offices beyond this reviewed selection. Its feed was unavailable to this collector.

sources.name: Department of Migrant Workers
sources.notes: Approved orders are not proof of remaining vacancies. The public feed was inaccessible; no unverified orders were imported.

sources.name: TESDA registered-program directory
sources.notes: All 746 observed pages were reviewed. Registry presence does not confirm an open intake, fee or scholarship.

sources.name: TESDA Online Program
sources.notes: Online access is distinct from a physical training center abroad. Each course keeps its own source review date.

sources.name: MWO Osaka / TESDA NLSC
sources.notes: For eligible OFWs in western and central Japan. Reconfirm registration and remaining places with MWO Osaka.
